goal: Standardize Enrollment, Review, breaking Intent revision, stale-authority repair, stop, user approval, and user-decision resolution on one bounded centered authority-dialog shell while preserving existing caller-owned attention, Review reason input, cancellation, freshness, capability, and Kernel semantics. Refine the existing three-row aboveEditor Task Rail to use a bounded short task identity and operation-specific next action without generic dialog instructions. Keep Footer content, timers, polling, watchers, percentage, ETA, persisted presentation state, embedded custom text editing, Tool schemas, Kernel operations, and persisted schemas unchanged.

acceptance.assertion: Enrollment and descriptor-waiver confirmation use the shared authority-dialog shell with bounded summary, collapsed details, described confirm and cancel actions, one-shot abort cleanup, and unchanged user-attention pairing and authority outcome.

Review and every ordinary Work authorization use the same shared dialog shell; only Review rework and reject continue to native reason input; cancel, blank reason, abort, session drift, and UI error retain existing attention cleanup and zero-authority-write behavior.

The Task Rail remains one three-row aboveEditor Widget, middle-truncates long task identity, presents business result and operation-specific next action without generic dialog instructions, preserves terminal cleanup, and publishes no defined Footer content.
